ops.title: nudge() state key resets on every capt-hook release
ops.description: nudge() and other primitives register a handler defined inside captain_hook/primitives/nudge.py, so RegisteredHook.source_file is captain-hook's own file. stamp_identity's relative_to(pack_dir) fails, _state_identity falls back to the absolute path under ~/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/<version>/..., and every capt-hook release yields a new state_key, resetting every nudge()'s max_fires counter mid-session. Evidence: session 900424b6 held 39 distinct keys for the cc-notes "cc-notes is installed" nudge (max_fires=1), each matching sha256 of that path for capt-hook 12.73.0..12.87.6; the nudge fired 73 times. Fix direction: register primitives with source_file=caller_file() (the pack module that called nudge()), as app.py's hook() already does. cc-notes #48 worked around it for three nudges by converting them to pack @on handlers; the commit-trailer and lease nudges in cc-notes workflow.py still reset.

ops.text: a nudge() max_fires counter survives a capt-hook version upgrade mid-session (state_key stable across ~/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/<version>/ paths)
